fieldData.content: Planned update of DNS for mainnet.radixdlt.com is scheduled for Saturday between 8 AM -  9 AM GMT. This may cause disruptions to wallets and explorer for short period of time until DNS update propagates to all ISP providers. This is not expected to be more than 30 minutes, but may vary from provider to provider.
fieldData.name: Potential disruption to wallets, explorer that access mainnet gateway
